title: Spectate feed and pure run-evidence file are placed with a bare resolve() rather than safeResolve
body:
Deferred from the 2026-08-28/29 audit fix pass. The finding was confirmed by an
adversarial verifier; it was not fixed in that pass for the reason below, which is
the fixing agent's own account after reading the code.

I agree with the VERIFIER CORRECTION: neither AF_SPECTATE nor --run-evidence crosses the MCP trust boundary — both are read once at import from argv/env by whoever spawns `npm run mcp`, and that actor already executes arbitrary repo code and controls argv directly. It is not an escalation, so hardening it would be defence-in-depth with no threat behind it. What actually remains is a README sentence that overstates a guarantee covering only client-argument paths, and README.md is excluded.
